description:
Start a paid video job. Request follows POST /api/v1/videos/generations (supports mode="t2v", "i2v",
"r2v", "edit", "extend", and "a2v" with audio_url / reference_audio_urls).

HeyGen models (pass audio via audio_url or reference_audio_urls; when starting from text, run a 2-step
chain create_speech -> create_video with the returned WAV audio_url):
- heygen-avatar-6-turbo (6 RUB/s at 1080p, 10.50 RUB/s at 2k) & heygen-avatar-6 (12 RUB/s at 1080p,
  17.40 RUB/s at 2k): audio 2-180 s, resolution "1080p" (default) or "2k", optional motion_prompt
  (<= 1200 chars) and motion_expressiveness ("default"|"less"), in 3 modes: image_url + audio_url
  (image-to-video, mode="i2v"), avatar + audio_url (identity-to-video, mode="a2v", 1,248 studio
  presenters e.g. "Abigail Sofa Front", aspect_ratio in "16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:5", "5:4"), or
  video_url + audio_url (ref-video-to-video, mode="edit", animated/art clip 2-180 s, optional image_url).
- heygen-lipsync-v3 (mode="edit", video_url 3-300 s + audio_url 2-300 s): quality="speed" (6 RUB/s,
  default) or "precision" (12 RUB/s), paired start_time + end_time (end_time - start_time >= 1.0 s),
  disable_music_track, enable_speech_enhancement, enable_caption (outputs .srt in output.caption_url),
  and enable_dynamic_duration (1.25x hold with automatic refund of unused seconds).
- heygen-translate (mode="edit", video_url 3-480 s with speech): required output_language (178 languages,
  e.g. "Russian", "English", "Spanish (Spain)"), quality="speed" (6 RUB/s, default) or "precision"
  (12 RUB/s), translate_audio_only, speaker_num (1..20), enable_caption (output.caption_url), paired
  srt_url + srt_role ("input"|"output", owned .srt <= 2 MiB from upload_media / POST /uploads), and
  enable_dynamic_duration (1.25x hold with automatic refund of unused seconds).

Wan models:
- wan3.0: unified 2-30 s (480p/720p/1080p; 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, adaptive; no 21:9, no negative_prompt
  or shot_type). Multi-shot via `Shot N [start-end]:` in prompt (<= 20000 chars); smart_duration=true
  (duration_seconds=-1) locks source length in mode="edit"; extend_direction="continue"|"prequel" +
  extend_seconds for mode="extend"; shot_mode ("auto"|"single"|"multi"), prompt_extend; up to 10
  reference_image_urls, 5 reference_video_urls (<= 15 s total), 5 reference_audio_urls (1-15 s WAV/MP3)
  with input + output <= 30 s (cannot mix image_url/last_frame_image_url with reference_*).
  Explicit shot timestamps and quoted Russian lines disable DashScope prompt expansion.
- wan2.7-r2v: up to 5 reference_image_urls + reference_video_urls combined; reference_audio_urls bind 1:1
  as per-hero reference_voice (WAV/MP3 1-10 s) in reference order; optional image_url (first_frame); 2-15 s
  without ref video or 2-10 s with ref video; input video billing capped at 5 s total; negative_prompt <= 500.
- wan2.7-videoedit: mode="edit" on 2-10 s video_url + up to 4 optional reference_image_urls; 720p/1080p.
- wan2.2-animate-move (keeps photo bg) / wan2.2-animate-mix (actor swap keeping video scene): 1 image_url +
  1 single-person video_url (2-30 s), 720p, quality_mode="standard"|"pro" (15/25 fps), no prompt/audio,
  input video not billed.

For minimax-relight use create_video_relight; for minimax-camera-controls use create_video_camera;
for lightx-recamera / lightx-relight use create_lightx_recamera / create_lightx_relight;
for ltx-2.5-alpha-gen use create_video_alpha_gen;
for topaz/flux/runway/ltx25 video upscale use create_video_upscale.
Not for higgsfield-* models: use create_higgsfield_cinema / create_higgsfield_genjutsu /
create_higgsfield_restyle / create_higgsfield_wan_prime.

avatar.description: Studio presenter name for HeyGen Avatar 6 identity-to-video (1,248 presenters, e.g. 'Abigail Sofa Front').
avatar.title: Avatar

disable_music_track.description: Mute background music stem during lip-sync (heygen-lipsync-v3).
disable_music_track.title: Disable Music Track

enable_caption.description: Generate output .srt subtitles in output.caption_url (heygen-lipsync-v3, heygen-translate).
enable_caption.title: Enable Caption

enable_dynamic_duration.description: Adjust output video pace to fit speech (default false); reserves a 1.25x hold and refunds unused seconds on completion (heygen-lipsync-v3, heygen-translate).
enable_dynamic_duration.title: Enable Dynamic Duration

enable_speech_enhancement.description: Clean background noise on voice track (heygen-lipsync-v3).
enable_speech_enhancement.title: Enable Speech Enhancement

end_time.description: Partial lip-sync end second (must be paired with start_time; heygen-lipsync-v3).
end_time.title: End Time

motion_expressiveness.description: Gesture intensity for HeyGen Avatar 6: 'default' or 'less'.
motion_expressiveness.title: Motion Expressiveness

motion_prompt.description: Optional gesture and camera direction for HeyGen Avatar 6 (<= 1200 chars).
motion_prompt.title: Motion Prompt

output_language.description: Target language for heygen-translate (178 languages, e.g. 'Russian', 'English', 'Spanish (Spain)').
output_language.title: Output Language

quality.description: Tier for heygen-lipsync-v3 or heygen-translate: 'speed' (default) or 'precision'.
quality.title: Quality

srt_role.description: Role of srt_url for heygen-translate: 'input' (source transcript) or 'output' (ready translation).
srt_role.title: Srt Role

srt_url.description: Owned .srt subtitle URL from POST /api/v1/uploads (<= 2 MiB, UTF-8; must be paired with srt_role; heygen-translate).
srt_url.title: Srt Url

start_time.description: Partial lip-sync start second (must be paired with end_time, end_time - start_time >= 1.0s; heygen-lipsync-v3).
start_time.title: Start Time

translate_audio_only.description: Translate only the voice track without lip re-rendering (heygen-translate).
translate_audio_only.title: Translate Audio Only

name: create_video
